description: Search posts, read profiles, timelines, followers, mentions, replies, quotes, and trends through TwitterAPI.io.
limitations: Read-only public X data. Search is last 24 hours, ranked by Top. Posting is not offered. Each call uses the operator's TwitterAPI.io credits.
setup_hint: Connect with a TwitterAPI.io API key from https://twitterapi.io/dashboard.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search posts from the last 24 hours, ranked by Top. X operators (from:user, min_faves) work. Pass query.

tools.name: user
tools.description: One X profile. Pass a username (@optional) or user id.

tools.name: posts
tools.description: Recent posts from one account. Pass a username or user id.

tools.name: post
tools.description: One post. Pass a post id or an x.com / twitter.com status URL.

tools.name: followers
tools.description: Followers of one account. Pass a username.

tools.name: following
tools.description: Accounts one user follows. Pass a username.

tools.name: mentions
tools.description: Posts that mention one account. Pass a username.

tools.name: replies
tools.description: Replies under one post. Pass a post id or status URL.

tools.name: quotes
tools.description: Quote posts of one post. Pass a post id or status URL.

tools.name: trends
tools.description: Trending topics. Pass optional woeid (1 worldwide, 23424977 US).
